title: Local degree-zero Čech cocycle factorization
statement: Let X be a scheme, U a finite family of opens indexed by Fin r, G an O_X-module, and i in Fin r. Let A be the integer extension of G concentrated in degree zero and C the integer extension of the alternating Čech sheaf complex, both restricted to U i, with augmentation a:A→C. Every endomorphism f:C^0→C^0 satisfying f followed by d_0 equal to zero factors as π followed by a_0 for some π:C^0→A^0.

source.place: Tag 02FU (cohomology-lemma-covering-resolution), with the increasing-tuple convention of Tag 01FM

proof.text: Use the degree-zero presheaf insertion identity. Sheafify and restrict to U i; these functors are additive. Naturality of the cap unit and its local invertibility give a factorization of every endomorphism killed by the first differential: the boundary term vanishes. Identify sheafification of G.val with G using the counit, inverse to its unit. Finally conjugate through extendXIso at degrees zero and one and its functorial images. Transport the vanishing differential and the factorization through these isomorphisms.

theorem alternatingCechSheafAugmentation_restrict_degreeZero_factorization
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (G : X.Modules) (i : Fin r) :
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι
    let A := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      (((CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj G).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    let C := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      ((alternatingCechSheafComplex U G).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    let a : A ⟶ C := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (alternatingCechSheafAugmentation U G)
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    ∀ f : C.X 0 ⟶ C.X 0, f ≫ C.d 0 1 = 0 →
      ∃ π : C.X 0 ⟶ A.X 0, π ≫ a.f 0 = f
